svg.title: How gentle-accounts swaps credentials
svg.desc: pi auth.json entries are saved to the outgoing profile and loaded from the incoming one; claude-bridge gets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Illustration generated from the project's real messages, not a screenshot.
